sloka: स यूपाक्षवचः श्रुत्वा भ्रातुर्युधि पराजयम् ।कुम्भकर्णो विवृत्ताक्षो यूपाक्षमिदमब्रवीत् ।। ६.६०.७९ ।।।।
transliteration: sa yūpākṣavacaḥ śrutvā bhrāturyudhi parājayam ।kumbhakarṇo vivṛttākṣo yūpākṣamidamabravīt ।। 6.60.79 ।।।।

translations.english: "I will satisfy the Rakshasas with the flesh and blood of Rama and Lakshmana. You will see."
